title: Lord Jim
summary: A psychological and moral tale of a young British seaman who fails in a crisis and is haunted by his perceived cowardice. After deserting his ship, the Patna, during a pilgrimage disaster, Jim seeks redemption through isolation and eventual leadership among Malay tribesmen on a remote island. The novel explores themes of honor, guilt, and the burden of reputation, as Jim attempts to build a new life while confronting his past failures in an inquiry that exposes his inner turmoil.
